title: tool.call
description: The model called a tool. The platform sends this to the app and the app's method runs in the app's own process; tool.result closes it.

ToolCall.description: The model called a tool. The platform sends this to the app and the app's method runs in the app's own process; tool.result closes it.

call_id.description: The model's id for this call, which the result must repeat.

name.description: The tool's name, as declared in its ToolSpec.

arguments.description: The arguments the model chose, as JSON matching the tool's parameters.

speech_id.description: The reply during which the model called it.
